name: Yarn
summary: Yarn Classic or Berry; workspaces via yarn workspace from repo root.
notes: yarn workspace routes monorepos without cd.

name: Bun
summary: Runtime plus package manager; bun install / bun run.
notes: bun may invoke known scripts without run.

name: Deno
summary: Secure JS/TS runtime; deno.json tasks; URL imports.

name: Corepack
summary: Pins yarn/pnpm via package.json packageManager field.
notes: Prefer Corepack over npm -g for pnpm/yarn.

name: React
summary: UI library; usually controlled by a meta-framework.
mem: jsx/tsx; no CLI — parent owns dev
notes: Control tree points upward to Next/Vite.

name: Vue
summary: Progressive framework; often Vite or Nuxt.

name: Angular
summary: Full framework; angular.json workspace; ng CLI.
notes: Select project by name — do not cd into apps.

name: Svelte
summary: Compiler UI; SvelteKit usually owns the app shell.
shape: {pm} run dev via Vite or Kit

name: Astro
notes: astro dev is the usual entry.

name: Gatsby
notes: Prefer pinned scripts over global CLI.

name: Express
summary: Minimal Node HTTP framework; script-owned entry.

name: Electron
notes: Main vs renderer are two process trees.

name: Tauri
notes: Stay at repo root when scripts wrap tauri.
presets: dev=pnpm run tauri dev|build=pnpm run tauri build

name: Qwik
summary: Resumable framework; Vite plus Qwik City.

name: Lit
summary: Web Components base; Vite demos common.

name: Rollup
notes: Often library build, not app serve.

name: Turborepo
notes: Always from workspace root; --filter replaces cd.

name: Nx
notes: project:target from root — never cd into apps.

name: TypeScript
summary: Typed JS; tsc / tsconfig; project references.
notes: Project references select packages without cd.

name: pip
notes: Always python -m pip inside the intended venv.

name: uv
summary: Fast Astral PM/venv; uv sync / uv run from project root.
notes: uv run injects env — no manual activate required.

name: Poetry
summary: Dependency plus packaging; poetry.lock; poetry run.
notes: Stay at project root; poetry env is managed.

name: Pipenv
notes: Prefer pipenv run over pipenv shell for scripts.

name: Hatch
summary: Env plus packaging; hatch run env:script.
notes: Env name is part of the command grammar.

name: Django
summary: Batteries-included web; manage.py is the control CLI.

name: Flask
notes: FLASK_APP is part of the mental model.

name: FastAPI
summary: ASGI API framework; uvicorn owns the process.
notes: Uvicorn controls the process; FastAPI is the app object.

name: pytest
notes: Run from project root so conftest resolves.

name: Sphinx
notes: Prefer make -C docs from repo root.

name: Go
summary: Language plus toolchain; go.mod module root.
notes: Module root is standing position; ./... selects packages.

name: Maven
notes: Always from reactor root; -pl selects module.

name: Gradle
notes: :module:task from root — do not cd into modules.

name: Spring Boot
notes: Build tool owns process; Spring owns DI.

name: Kotlin
summary: Language on JVM; usually Gradle Kotlin DSL.
notes: kotlinc alone is rare in apps.

name: NuGet
summary: Package feed client; usually dotnet add package.

name: Composer
notes: Script names are Composer scripts, not shell files.

name: Laravel
summary: PHP framework; artisan is the control plane.
notes: Always from app root containing artisan.

name: Ruby on Rails
notes: Prefer bin/rails over rails from PATH.

name: Rake
notes: Task names are the script equivalents.

name: Dart / pub
summary: Language plus pub; pubspec.yaml; dart run.
shape: dart run / dart test / dart pub get
notes: dart pub get from package root.

name: React Native
notes: Native dirs are controlled by RN CLI / Expo.

name: Docker
notes: Build context is a directory — surface it.

name: Docker Compose
notes: Service names are the units — not directories.

name: Helm
notes: Release name plus values file are the mental model.

name: Pulumi
summary: IaC in general languages; Pulumi.yaml; stack select.
notes: Stack name is the environment standing position.

name: Ansible
notes: Inventory is as important as the playbook.

name: Wrangler
presets: dev=pnpm exec wrangler dev|deploy=pnpm exec wrangler deploy

name: Prisma
notes: Run from package that owns prisma/.
presets: generate=pnpm exec prisma generate|migrate=pnpm exec prisma migrate dev

name: Drizzle
presets: generate=pnpm exec drizzle-kit generate|push=pnpm exec drizzle-kit push

name: Sequelize
notes: Config file locates migrations without cd.

name: Diesel
summary: Rust ORM; diesel.toml; diesel migration run.
notes: DATABASE_URL is part of standing env.

name: PostgreSQL
notes: App tools own migrations; psql is the console.

name: Redis
notes: Usually a service dependency, not a project CLI.

name: Jest
notes: Prefer pnpm test so config resolves.

name: Vitest
notes: Often same config root as Vite.
presets: test=pnpm exec vitest|run=pnpm exec vitest run

name: Playwright
notes: Install browsers once; run from package root.
presets: test=pnpm exec playwright test|ui=pnpm exec playwright test --ui

name: Cypress
notes: open vs run is interactive vs headless.
presets: run=pnpm exec cypress run|open=pnpm exec cypress open

name: Storybook
notes: Separate process from app dev server.

name: ESLint
notes: Flat config is the modern standing file.

name: Biome
notes: Single tool replaces eslint plus prettier in many repos.
presets: check=pnpm exec biome check .|format=pnpm exec biome format --write .

name: dprint
summary: Polyglot formatter; dprint.json; used across Dev-Centr.

name: GitHub Actions
notes: Mental model is job graph, not a local cwd.

name: Git
notes: Repo root is default standing position.

name: GitHub CLI
notes: Always from a git checkout with GitHub remote.

name: pre-commit
notes: Install hooks once; run from repo root.

name: Husky
notes: Hooks fire from git — not a manual CLI usually.

name: Changesets
presets: add=pnpm exec changeset|version=pnpm exec changeset version

name: VitePress
notes: Docs root may differ from repo root.

name: CMake
notes: Never in-source build; -B is the standing build dir.

name: Vercel CLI
notes: --scope selects team; Root Directory is a Vercel setting.
presets: dev=pnpm exec vercel dev|deploy=pnpm exec vercel deploy

name: Netlify CLI
presets: dev=pnpm exec netlify dev|deploy=pnpm exec netlify deploy

name: Firebase CLI
presets: emulators=pnpm exec firebase emulators:start|deploy=pnpm exec firebase deploy

name: Convex
summary: Reactive backend; convex/; npx convex dev.
presets: dev=pnpm exec convex dev|deploy=pnpm exec convex deploy

name: Stripe CLI
mem: webhook endpoint; API keys in env
notes: Local listen bridges to app port.

name: AWS CLI
summary: AWS control plane CLI; profiles; region.
notes: Profile/region are standing position — not cwd.

name: gcloud
summary: Google Cloud CLI; configurations; project set.

name: Swift / SPM
shape: swift build / swift test / swift run

name: GraphQL
notes: Codegen is a build step — surface schema path.

name: Protocol Buffers
summary: IDL plus codegen; .proto; buf or protoc.

name: Tailwind CSS
notes: Almost always driven by Vite/Next — not a standalone server.

name: OpenAPI
notes: Spec file is the standing artifact.
